# Awesome MCP Servers

> A community directory of Model Context Protocol servers by AI Anytime. Hosted endpoints are sent an MCP handshake nightly; status values are live (answers without credentials), auth (reachable, needs credentials), down, or unprobed (local or no endpoint). A listing is not a security audit.

- [Every server in full, as plain text](https://mcp.aianytime.net/llms-full.txt)
- [Full data as JSON](https://mcp.aianytime.net/api/servers.json)
- [Live status of every hosted server](https://mcp.aianytime.net/status/)
- [Servers that need no account](https://mcp.aianytime.net/c/no-auth/)
- [Local stdio servers](https://mcp.aianytime.net/c/local/)
- [Source and how to add a server](https://github.com/AIAnytime/Awesome-MCP-Servers)

## [Agents, IDEs & developer tools](https://mcp.aianytime.net/c/developer-tools/)

- [Agent QA](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/agent-qa/): [stdio, unprobed] Author, validate, run, and inspect natural-language web and mobile regression tests, with persistent test memory. Install: npx -y agent-qa mcp
- [AI Developer Toolkit MCP](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/ai-developer-toolkit-mcp/): [http, live] Read-only search and fetch over 950+ guides on AI-assisted development (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) in English and Polish. No account or API key. Endpoint: https://developertoolkit.ai/mcp · Registry: io.github.mjaskolski Endpoint: https://developertoolkit.ai/mcp.
- [Aident Loadout](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/aident-loadout/): [http, auth] Connect Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT and other MCP clients to 1,000+ apps and 400+ Skills through one reusable setup with Vault-protected credentials. Endpoint: https://loadout.aident.ai/mcp · Docs · Website · Reg Endpoint: https://loadout.aident.ai/mcp.
- [AIHawk](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/aihawk/): [stdio, unprobed] AI browser agent that browses, clicks, types, and reads real web pages from plain-English instructions. Install: uvx aihawk
- [Antigravity Link](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/antigravity-link/): [stdio, unprobed] Mirror active AI chat sessions from Google's Antigravity IDE to your phone: send messages, upload files, stop generation, automate workflows across 9 tools. Registry: io.github.cafeTechne/antigravity-link
- [API.market MCP Gateway](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/api-market-mcp-gateway/): [http, auth] Discover and call 580+ APIs through five gateway tools, with OAuth or API-key authentication; pricing and free tiers vary by API. Endpoint: https://api.market/api/mcp/gateway Endpoint: https://api.market/api/mcp/gateway.
- [Apple Docs 2.0 MCP](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/apple-docs-2-0-mcp/): [stdio, unprobed] Searches and reads Apple's developer documentation, Human Interface Guidelines and 1,700 WWDC sessions with code, with an offline index of 336,629 pages. Install: npx -y apple-docs-2.0-mcp
- [Archcore](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/archcore/): [stdio, unprobed] Git-native context engineering CLI and MCP server for AI coding agents. Keep specs, ADRs, rules, plans, and project knowledge in Git. Install: curl -fsSL https://archcore.ai/install.sh | bash · Docs
- [Bestax](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/bestax/): [stdio, unprobed] Props, working examples, --bulma-* CSS variables and Agent Skills for Bestax, a React component library for Bulma v1; offline, no API key. Install: npx -y bestax-mcp@1 · Docs

- [claude-node](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/claude-node/): [stdio, unprobed] Python subprocess bridge to the Claude Code CLI, giving Python direct access to Claude Code's native capabilities over stream-json.
- [CurlShot](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/curlshot/): [http, live] Renders any public URL as a PNG, JPEG or WebP screenshot, a PDF, or a scrolling video, full page or at a phone, tablet or desktop preset. list_devices needs no key; take_screenshot needs an API key as a Bearer token (fre Endpoint: https://curlshot.com/api/mcp.
- [ERIUS PHONE MCP](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/erius-phone-mcp/): [stdio, unprobed] Drive a hosted ERIUS PHONE Android phone or tablet: read the screen as an accessibility tree or screenshot, tap, type, swipe, launch apps, install APKs and pull crash logs. Requires an ERIUS PHONE API key (early access).

- [Hexis](https://mcp.aianytime.net/s/hexis/): [http, auth] Git-backed platform for skills, tools, and context for AI agents. Endpoint: https://demo.bevel.software/api/mcp Endpoint: https://demo.bevel.software/api/mcp.
